segments.normalizedSource: ```swift func isTargetVisibleAtAngle(angle: CGFloat, distance: CGFloat) -> Bool { let rayStart = CGPoint.zero let rayEnd = CGPoint(x: distance * cos(angle), y: distance * sin(angle)) let body = scene.physicsWorld.body(alongRayStart: rayStart, end: rayEnd) return body?.categoryBitMask == targetCategory } func attackTargetIfVisible() { if isTargetVisibleAtAngle(angle: cannon.zRotation, distance: 512) { shootCannon() } ```
